placements.title: Preserving derivative transcripts indefinitely while expiring raw audio capture
placements.frame: How should raw observational recordings and structured transcripts be differentiated across retention lifecycles?
placements.why: Odette and Linus settle the operational policy of deleting raw field recordings at eighteen months while preserving transcripts permanently.

placements.title: Grounding diagnostic assessments in warehouse frontline operations before management engagement
placements.frame: How should stakeholder interview sequencing prioritize operational frontline reality before management framing?
placements.why: Linus and Odette establish the Thistlewick diagnostic structure as a two-week engagement sequenced through warehouse teams prior to management.

placements.title: Scheduling orchard grafting strictly after frost termination in late March
placements.frame: What seasonal weather conditions and calendar windows govern grafting operations?
placements.why: Odette articulates and Linus confirms that orchard grafting occurs in late March following the cessation of frosts.
